results.heading: First visit
results.text: A first visit takes about 30 minutes and includes a check-up and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray. Please bring your ID and any recent X-rays.

results.heading: Children
results.text: We see children from age 4. A parent or guardian must be present for patients under 18.

results.heading: Booking an appointment
results.text: New and existing patients can book by email or phone. Tell us what the visit is for (check-up, pain, hygiene, whitening) and two or three preferred days; reception confirms a time.

results.heading: Visit length
results.text: Check-ups and hygiene visits take 30 minutes. Fillings take 45–60 minutes. Whitening takes 90 minutes.

args.subject: Re: Dental check-up for my daughter
args.body:
Dear Sezal,

Thank you for getting in touch. We would be happy to see your daughter for a check-up and hygiene visit.

What to bring: please bring your ID and any recent X-rays. A first visit takes about 30 minutes and includes a check-up and, if needed, a panoramic X-ray. [booking#first-visit]

Children: we see children from age 4, and a parent or guardian must be present for patients under 18, so you will need to attend with her. [before-visit#children]

Booking: check-ups and hygiene visits take 30 minutes. [booking#visit-length]

Since you are flexible, I would be glad to suggest times. Could you let us know two or three days that suit you best? Reception will then confirm a time with you. You're also welcome to reply with any questions beforehand.

Warm regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
